Shandong Binzhou Huike Cyclodextrin Technology Co., Ltd. is a leading high-tech enterprise located in the Boxing Economic Development Zone of Binzhou, Shandong Province, China. Specializing in the research, development, production, and commercialization of cyclodextrin and its derivatives, the company plays a vital role in the advancement of advanced chemical materials for various industrial applications. Leveraging cutting-edge biotechnology and modern fermentation techniques, Huike Technology produces high-purity cyclodextrins—cyclic oligosaccharides known for their unique molecular encapsulation properties—that are widely used in pharmaceuticals, food and beverage, cosmetics, agriculture, and environmental protection.

Founded with a vision to become a global leader in functional cyclodextrin solutions, the company integrates scientific innovation with stringent quality control standards, conforming to international regulations such as ISO and GMP. Its state-of-the-art manufacturing facilities are equipped with automated processes and environmentally sustainable practices, minimizing waste and energy consumption. The company actively collaborates with renowned research institutions and universities to drive continuous innovation and expand the application scope of cyclodextrin-based technologies.

With a strong commitment to customer satisfaction, product safety, and green development, Shandong Binzhou Huike Cyclodextr UTC Technology Co., Ltd. has established a robust supply network across domestic and international markets. Its products are trusted by multinational corporations and have earned a reputation for reliability, performance, and technical excellence. As the demand for advanced functional ingredients grows globally, Huike continues to strengthen its R&D capabilities and production capacity to meet evolving industry needs.
